hero.intro: ~Self-taught in~ Gabès, Tunisia. ~I build, deploy and ship software for~ real businesses.

about.bio: I’m a self-taught developer from Gabès, in the south of Tunisia. I learned by building real things for real people, and I still work that way: I design it, build it, put it on a server and keep it running. Today I do that for businesses through Jasper Tech.
